Role Definitions

            

              

                
Admin

                
Full access: read, write, manage namespaces, configure settings, export reports

              

              

                
Operator

                
Operations: read, write (agree/dismiss/ack changes), export reports

              

              

                
Viewer

                
Read-only: view dashboards and export reports, no actions
